## cli-cell-and-source-ops

**Governed hosted cell plan/apply and sealed source pull CLI** — status: `implemented` | evidence tier: `runtime-enforced`

### Spec contracts

- `docs/spec/core/06-composition-config.md`
- `docs/spec/core/07-world-boundary.md`

### Linked invariants & gates

- `artifact-governance-lean` (artifact-governance/proof)
- `ontology-mapping-provenance-lean` (ontology/proof)

### Owned surfaces

- `cli:norn cell apply`
- `cli:norn cell plan`
- `cli:norn source pull`

### Source paths

- `crates/norn-cli/src/cell.rs`
- `crates/norn-cli/src/source.rs`

### Probe

- **Drive:** Run `norn cell plan --url <loopback> --org <org> --env <env> --token-env NORN_DEV_TOKEN <pack-dir>` followed by `norn cell apply`, and test `norn source pull --crosswalk-env <VAR> --connector <connector.json> --extracted-at-ms <ms>` against a loopback mock/ERPNext endpoint.
- **Observable end state:** `cell plan` prints diff without mutating cell state; `cell apply` atomically installs the next revision; `source pull` issues GET-only reads (`SRC-READ-1`), binds identity solely via the reviewed crosswalk (`SRC-IDENT-1`), and fails closed on read errors (`SRC-LIVE-1`).
- **Gotchas:**
  - Never pass bearer tokens or passwords directly as CLI arguments; `cell` and `source` intentionally accept `--token-env` / `--crosswalk-env` only.

### Probe

- **Drive:** Run `norn check --source tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org example --env local` (and `--artifacts <json> --context <ctx>`), then run `norn explain concept <id> --defs <json> --format json`.
- **Observable end state:** `norn check` prints a canonical report with `admitted`, diagnostics, and `receiptSha256` without installing definitions; `norn explain` renders the shared JSON/text explanation with honest proof status.

### Source paths

- `crates/norn-cli/src/mcp.rs`
- `crates/norn-cli/src/remote.rs`

### Probe

- **Drive:** Run `norn capabilities`, send a bounded JSON-RPC `tools/list` line over stdio to `norn mcp`, and drive `norn remote list --url <mcp-url> --org <org> --env <env> --token-env <VAR>` plus `norn remote call <tool> --idempotency-key <key>`.
- **Observable end state:** `capabilities` returns paginated tool definitions (`<= 32` per page) and `catalogDigest`; `mcp` serves bounded stdio JSON-RPC; `remote list/call` mirrors the live server catalog and forwards trace/idempotency metadata.
- **Gotchas:**
  - A `capabilities` cursor is bound to the working directory and catalog digest; restart pagination without `--cursor` after revisions.

## cli-offline-eval-and-contracts

**Offline decision evaluation, OpenAPI contract emission, and HOST-TREE-1 source digest CLI** — status: `implemented` | evidence tier: `runtime-enforced`

### Spec contracts

### Owned surfaces

### Source paths

- `crates/norn-cli/src/main.rs`
- `crates/norn-cli/src/eval.rs`
- `crates/norn-api/src/openapi.rs`
- `crates/norn-ir/src/source_tree.rs`

### Probe

- **Drive:** Run `norn openapi` and diff against `sdks/openapi/norn-api.openapi.json`, run `norn source-digest crates/norn-ir`, and run `norn eval --defs <dir> --org <org> --env <env> --rule <id>` over sample JSON-lines stdin.
- **Observable end state:** `norn openapi` matches the checked-in OpenAPI document byte-for-byte; `norn source-digest` returns deterministic `{digest, files}` skipping hidden entries and `target/` while refusing symlinks; `norn eval` evaluates admitted closures within `--units` budget.
- **Gotchas:**
  - `norn source-digest` refuses visible symlinks, sockets/FIFOs, and non-UTF-8 filenames by contract (`HOST-TREE-1`).
